title: GCA Tower-Defense Map Layout (SSOT)
description: The gameplay-authoritative map geometry for a tower_defence game, authored ONCE in `levels/map-layout.json` and shared across stages. The game code renders the visible road by stroking the SAME Phaser.Curves.Path the enemies walk, and places core/spawn/build-slot props from these coordinates. The map-base art is terrain-only and MUST NOT bake this geometry (a stochastic image model cannot reproduce exact coordinates). All coordinates are map pixel space matching `canvas`. This shape is identical to the `map_layout` property of level_schema.json. Validated by gateMapLayoutPresent.

canvas.description: Pixel space the coordinates live in. Must equal the game screen / map-base dimensions.

road_width.description: Visible road stroke width (px), used by the code-rendered road and by render_layout_mask.

core.description: The defended objective position. Every path's last waypoint equals this point.

spawns.description: Enemy entry portals. Each path starts at one of these.

paths.description: Ordered enemy routes. Each is a polyline from a spawn to the core. Enemies walk these EXACT waypoints; the visible road is stroked from the same polyline (constructive consistency guarantee).

spawn.description: id of the spawn this path starts at; waypoints[0] must equal that spawn's (x,y).

unlocked_at_wave.description: 1-indexed wave at/after which this route is active (enables progressive path unlocks).

waypoints.description: Ordered (x,y) points. First == the spawn position, last == the core position.

fork_nodes.description: Optional visual junction markers where paths diverge or converge (decorative anchors; not required for walk geometry).

build_slots.description: Tower placement anchors. x/y is the footprint center. A slot must clear every path by road_width/2 + max(width,height)/2 + build_slot_margin_px, UNLESS it sets on_path:true for lane defence (enforced by gateMapLayoutPresent).

on_path.description: Lane-defence slot: the defender stands ON the route rather than beside it (plants on a lawn lane). Inverts the geometry requirement — instead of clearing the road, the slot footprint MUST overlap it, so the flag cannot be used to smuggle an off-road slot past the clearance check. Requires gates.tower_defence.map_layout.allow_on_path_build_slots.
